scope: Corollary C.7 (Fixed generators and neutral algebraic extensions) of the manuscript “Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions” (preprints/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d97ba60373419ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In Lemma C.3, let gi,1, . . . , gi,ri be any finite list contained in S(C1LiDi) for one fixed C1. For all sufficiently large i, the entire field Fi = k(gi,1, . . . , gi,ri ), and its relative algebraic closure inside k(Vi), lie in K∗,i. Thus every test from part (ii) is exactly zero on every nonzero element of these fields at that same index, without a degree-dependent eventual qualification. More generally, a valuation trivial on a subfield remains trivial on any algebraic extension of it inside its valued overfield.
